description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses from a specific MTD partition on a Phicomm K2T device. It defines functions to load configuration data and retrieve MAC addresses from JSON structures, relying on external shell libraries for JSON parsing and system utilities.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads JSON configuration data from a specific MTD partition named 'config'. It finds the partition, reads its size, validates, and loads the JSON data.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves a MAC address or other value from the loaded JSON configuration using a key provided as an argument.
